title: Route-level behavior is untested: only the price-guard pure function has coverage
reasoning: The only test file associated with this source group covers the exported evaluatePriceGuard helper (two happy/sad path cases) and never exercises any route handler. All the validation, auth, error-mapping, and RPC-verification logic in swap.ts, tp-sl.ts, positions.ts, liquidity.ts, pools.ts, tokens.ts, and v3-quote.ts is unguarded — which is why the parameter-validation and id-precision defects above exist without regression protection. The project has the tooling for this (@cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers in devDependencies).
recommendation: Add handler-level tests using @cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers covering at minimum: swap /quote param validation, tp-sl create/verify flow and large-id round-trip, positions reconcile ownership checks, and pools sortBy whitelist.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: This finding is itself the gap: price-guard.test.ts covers only the pure evaluatePriceGuard function and contains no route or middleware tests.
minimumFixScope: Add route-level test files under apps/api/test/ for swap, tp-sl, positions, and pools handlers.
